cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me serve first in the final, even if it costs you the match. Your old coach could use that advantage; I taught you to support the person beside you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to compete. Why give you the first serve?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A good memory when it suits you. You said you were on my side today; let me see it when there's a point to lose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd be pleased for you if you won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose to receive and give your old coach the first serve. You can still try to beat me afterward.
